author: Zero_linofe
description:
Simple layout keys; currently most buttons are vanilla keys. Using modpacks or changing key settings may make keys unusable. 

Key notes:
"Zoom" -> "v".
"Map" -> "m".
"Quick Return to Island" -> automatically enters the return command "/is".
Hold F3 to open the F3 function screen.

When using it, it is recommended to set the mouse control mode to Drag.
